translated_title: The Uncomfortable Ally Splits Off: Hugo Eric Flores, Now with PAZ, Rails Against Morena
original_title: El aliado incómodo se separa: Hugo Eric Flores, ahora PAZ, echa pestes contra Morena
author: Obed Rosas
meta_description: Hugo Eric Flores — a former Morena ally who now heads the new evangelical party PAZ — accuses the ruling party of squandering the 2018 “moral and social legitimacy,” leaving the old political system intact, and deepening Mexico’s polarization.
